correctness.rationale: The two hyperplane factors x and y+t z cut six distinct transverse branch points on smooth E for t²!=1; Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus four. Complete-intersection Hasse–Witt coefficient extraction from (PQ)^{p−1} yields exactly diag(0,0,0,t²−2) for p=5 and diag(3,3t³−2t,0,t³−2t) for p=7. Independently reconstructed all sixteen polynomial entries at both p via exact multinomial enumeration. Each nonzero diagonal entry survives Frobenius iteration, so ranks and a-numbers follow over algebraic closure, not merely prime field. Elliptic Hasse invariant 0 at p5 and 3 at p7; the degree-two Prym splitting is prime-to-p and preserves p-divisible invariants, giving the Prym table. Exceptional root sets are disjoint off t²=1.

originality.rationale: The 2024 Ogasawara–Ohashi–Sakata–Harashita primary paper establishes the general double-elliptic model, smoothness criterion, coefficient extraction formula and full genus-four superspecial classification, including known p5 one isomorphism class and no p7 superspecial Jacobians. Those are not claimed new. Its relevant full HTML theorem/appendices/conclusion do not state the parameter-by-parameter full Cartier strata of this cyclic family, nor the superspecial Prym over an ordinary E at p7 t=0. These require evaluating and factoring the full special matrix and prime-to-p Prym decomposition. Earlier implicit computation remains residual risk.
